annotations.title: Ask Printdash to re-price a past job (asks first)

description: For a job on a past order that Printdash's team priced (reorder_by_request in get_order): prepares the order page's reorder request, at the same or another quantity with optional notes, and returns the summary to show the customer and a confirmation_token. Nothing is filed until confirm is called after the customer agrees; then the team confirms today's price and sends a quote or pay link. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

item_id.description: The job's item_id from get_order (optional on a one-job order).

notes.description: Any change to the specs, in the customer's words.

order.description: The order number (or the order id from its link).

name: request_reorder

summary.description: Show this to the customer exactly as written before confirming.
